map.CPK 过程能力指数 使用指南: CPK Process Capability Index User Guide
map.输入规格上下限、样本均值与标准差，计算制程能力指数CPK（合格线≥1.33），评: Enter the upper and lower specification limits, the sample mean and the standard deviation to compute the process capability index CPK (1.33 or above is acceptable), assessing whether the process meets quality and stability requirements.
map.来料或过程质量判定时，用 CPK/CP 评估过程能力是否满足规格，决定接收或调整: When judging incoming or in-process quality, use CPK/CP to assess whether process capability meets the specification, deciding to accept or to adjust the process.
map.过程居中性核查时，用 CA 偏移系数判断均值是否偏离公差中心，指导设备/参数调校: When checking whether the process is centered, use the CA shift factor to judge whether the mean has drifted from the center of the tolerance and guide equipment or parameter tuning.
map.长期稳定性监控时，用 PPK（长期）与 CPK（短期）对比，识别随时间漂移的特殊: For long-term stability monitoring, compare PPK (long term) with CPK (short term) to identify special causes that drift over time.
map.：某轴径规格 9.5–10.5mm、实测均值 10.0mm、标准差 0.1mm、: A shaft diameter specification of 9.5-10.5mm has a measured mean of 10.0mm, a standard deviation of 0.1mm and 30 samples. Tolerance T = 10.5 - 9.5 = 1.0mm; CP = 1.0/(6*0.1) = 1.67; CPU = (10.5 - 10.0)/(3*0.1) = 1.67, CPL = (10.0 - 9.5)/0.3 = 1.67, CPK = min = 1.67; the tolerance center is 10.0mm, CA = |10.0 - 10.0|/(1.0/2) = 0% (centered, no shift); the long-term PPK corrected for sample size is about 1.66. Conclusion: CPK >= 1.33 means capability is acceptable and well centered.
map.CPK 和 CP 有什么不同？: What's the Difference Between CPK and CP?
map.CP 只看公差宽度与过程离散度（潜力），不考虑均值偏移；CPK = min(CP: CP looks only at tolerance width and process spread (potential) and ignores mean shift; CPK = min(CPU, CPL) accounts for the shift as well and reflects real capability better. When the mean is centered, CPK = CP; the larger the shift, the smaller CPK.
map.一般工业：CPK≥1.33 合格（推荐），≥1.67 能力过剩可放宽公差，1.0: General industry: CPK >= 1.33 is acceptable (recommended), >= 1.67 means capacity is overabundant and tolerances can be relaxed, 1.0-1.33 is borderline and needs improvement, < 1.0 is insufficient. Automotive and similar industries often require >= 1.33 or even >= 1.67.
